notes.title: First Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
We are finally happy to announce our first update. If I must tell the truth this is the sum of 7-8 patches but, in order to keep this simple, we decided to summarize everything in one go.
http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/update1.jpg


General:

- Improved Core engine stability and performance.
- Improved the text speed option.
- Improved quality of the characters models.
- Improved the general quality of the Chinese, Spanish, English and Italian script.
- Fixed issues related to save slots
- (Player request) The skip function works a little bit faster now.

Mac:
- Fixed start up issues with the Mac build.
- 18+ Patch now works for Mac users too.


18+ Patch 
-Corrected a critical bug that caused the game not to show the correct story script .
- Corrected issues with the skip option
- Added some missing artworks and scenes.


Last but not least:
We are paying close attention to your reviews!
We will be happy to translate our 18+ version but it will depend on our translators' availability.
Please keep supporting us, your feedback is really important.


Special Thanks to our Chinese translator Smile菁菁.
Thanks for your support so far and have a nice day!

<3 Neoclassic Games
